candidates.source_name: ČTK Protext – national press-release distribution service (Czech News Agency)
candidates.why_relevant: Protext is the press-release wire operated by ČTK (Česká tisková kancelář), the Czech national news agency. Corporate announcements submitted here are distributed alongside ČTK news to media, state administration and the economic sphere, and are published in full text on protext.cz plus (per the operator) 27 Czech news portals. For banking and payments this is the single sweep that captures announcements from banks, insurers, asset managers, payment institutions and fintechs — including entities too small to maintain a discoverable IR page. The public web archive persists after the issuing company changes or prunes its own newsroom.
candidates.access_status: open web, no login for reading
candidates.legal_status: publicly published PR content; ČTK/Protext copyright applies to presentation — redistribution of full text likely restricted, metadata and analysis fine
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of category and search pages (HTML, server-rendered, paginated). Store title, timestamp, issuing organisation, full text, canonical URL. Poll daily.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of known national wire domain, then link-snowball into category and search pages
queries_used: ČTK Protext tisková zpráva distribuce banka platební služby (attempted; WebSearch budget exhausted)

candidates.source_name: Protext – category 'Finance, ekonomika' release stream
candidates.why_relevant: The finance/economics slice of the Protext wire — the highest-density single URL for Czech banking and payments press releases. Observed on fetch: dated items (DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM), pagination running to roughly 440 pages, and issuers including Komerční banka (KB+ client numbers; fraud statistics), Česká bankovní asociace (macroeconomic forecast 3Q 2026), Generali Investments and a Visa Czech Top Shop announcement. This gives a multi-year, multi-actor archive in one paginated structure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated HTML crawl (?page=N) with incremental stop-on-seen; backfill the full ~440-page archive once, then daily delta.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from protext.cz homepage category list

candidates.source_name: Protext advanced search (vyhledávání) – full wire archive query interface
candidates.why_relevant: Query interface over the whole Protext archive. Observed filters: free text (Hledaný text), date range (Datum od / Datum do), origin (vše / ČR / zahraničí) and release language (vše / čeština / angličtina). The page reported 50,525 records found for the unfiltered query, with page-numbered pagination. This is the practical harvesting entry point for keyword sweeps such as 'banka', 'platební', 'platební instituce', 'karty', 'terminál'.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scripted keyword + date-window queries against the search form; the result list paginates via a page parameter. Run a Czech and an English pass (the language filter exposes both).
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from protext.cz homepage

candidates.source_name: Protext submission/client portal (protext.ctk.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: The client-facing side of the ČTK wire. Documents how Czech corporate announcements physically enter the media system: service running since 1999, distribution to 27 Czech news portals and media in nearly 180 countries, guaranteed publication within 4 hours (usually under 2), category targeting, premium portal placement, and monitoring reports at 2h and 48h after publication. Registration is free and one-off submission without registration is possible — which explains why very small payment institutions and fintechs appear on the wire without any newsroom of their own. Useful for modelling distribution latency and for enumerating the downstream mirror portals.
candidates.access_status: public marketing pages; account required to submit
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off documentation read; re-check annually for changes to the mirror-portal list and pricing packages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from protext.cz ('submission platform' reference)

candidates.source_name: České noviny – PR servis (ČTK/Protext mirror)
candidates.why_relevant: ČTK's own consumer news site mirrors the Protext PR feed in a dedicated /pr/ section. Confirmed on fetch: items dated (Aug 2026 range), a 'Všechny zprávy' loader, and financial-sector releases present (KB+ client-numbers release). Individual items follow the pattern /tiskove/zpravy/<slug>/<numeric-id>, which gives stable, citable permalinks with a numeric identifier — often easier to key on than the company's own CMS URLs. Acts as a redundant copy if protext.cz blocks automated access.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /pr/ plus the ajax 'all news' loader; dedupe against protext.cz by title+timestamp; keep the numeric item id as a stable key.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from ceskenoviny.cz footer ('PR servis' → Protext)

candidates.source_name: České noviny – Ekonomika (ČTK economic wire; successor of financninoviny.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: ČTK's edited economic news stream, where wire journalists rewrite or amplify bank and payment-company announcements. Important as the editorial counterpart to the raw PR feed: an item appearing here (rather than only in /pr/) signals that ČTK judged it newsworthy, which is a useful salience filter. Note the former dedicated finance domain financninoviny.cz now 301-redirects here, so legacy links and bookmarks resolve to this path.
candidates.legal_status: public; ČTK copyright, full-text redistribution restricted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of the section index plus RSS (an RSS link is present in the site footer); store headline, timestamp, canonical URL.
candidates.discovered_via_method: 301 redirect observed when fetching https://www.financninoviny.cz/

candidates.source_name: ČTK services hub (Infobanka, ČTK Connect, News Select, Fotobanka)
candidates.why_relevant: Catalogue of the national agency's commercial products, which is where the deep, licensable archive lives: Infobanka (news database and archive), ČTK Connect (PR distribution and events), News Select (mobile news app), PressCentrum ČTK (press-conference venue — a useful signal of where Czech financial announcements are physically staged), Fotobanka/Videobanka. Infobanka is the route to historical full-text agency coverage that is not on the free web.
candidates.access_status: catalogue open; Infobanka and Connect are commercial/subscription
candidates.legal_status: licensed products — a subscription contract governs any bulk use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read for orientation; if deep historical coverage is needed, negotiate an Infobanka licence rather than scraping. Contact ctk@ctk.cz / +420 222 098 111.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from protext.cz 'related services'

candidates.source_name: NEWTON Media – mediální archiv and PR Studio
candidates.why_relevant: The dominant Czech media-monitoring house. Its archive is advertised as covering press and online 'od roku 1989', i.e. deeper than any free web source, and it also operates PR Studio (press-release management/distribution) and Mediabase (journalist/influencer database). For this cell it is both a retrospective archive of how bank announcements were picked up and a competing distribution channel to ČTK Protext. Mediabase indirectly reveals which journalists cover Czech banking and payments.
candidates.legal_status: subscription/licensed; content is third-party copyright — no scraping, use contracted export
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Commercial subscription with API/export, or a scoped trial to test banking/payments query recall. Do not scrape.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the leading Czech media-monitoring vendor domain

candidates.source_name: Anopress IT – Czech media database
candidates.why_relevant: Long-standing Czech full-text media archive and monitoring provider, the main alternative to NEWTON Media for retrospective coverage of bank and payment-company announcements. Recorded here as a candidate to be re-verified: the fetch from this environment failed at the TLS layer, which is a transport-level failure, not evidence that the service is gone.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-verify from a normal browser; if live, evaluate as a licensed archive alongside NEWTON. Do not treat as dead on this single failure.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of known Czech media-archive vendor domain
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch returned 'certificate has expired' — likely local TLS interception or an expired cert; liveness unresolved

candidates.source_name: Monitora – media monitoring platform
candidates.why_relevant: Newer Czech/Slovak media-monitoring platform frequently used by mid-sized brands; relevant as a lower-cost route to tracking pickup of banking and payments press releases across Czech online media. Recorded as unverified — the fetch failed at the TLS layer from this environment.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-verify from a normal browser; assess free tier and API before committing.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of known Czech monitoring vendor domain
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch returned 'self signed certificate' — transport-level failure, liveness unresolved

candidates.source_name: MediaGuru – Czech media, marketing and PR trade news
candidates.why_relevant: Trade news site ('zpravodajský web o médiích, marketingu a reklamě', operated by PHD s.r.o.). Its /pr section reports on PR mandates, agency wins and campaign launches — which is how one learns that a given bank or payment company has changed its communications agency or is about to run a launch push. Also carries a media dictionary (medialni-slovnik) useful for building the Czech PR/media glossary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /pr and /marketing filtered for banking/payments actor names from the actor map.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of known Czech media trade-press domain

candidates.source_name: Mediář – daily Czech media/marketing news and PR agency index
candidates.why_relevant: Independent daily (News Media s.r.o., editor Ondřej Aust) with dedicated /pr/ and /agentury/ sections listing dozens of Czech PR agencies. Snowballing the agency index identifies the intermediaries that write and place bank and payments press releases — a route to announcements that never reach a corporate newsroom, and a way to anticipate campaigns.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off harvest of /agentury/ to build the agency map; weekly monitoring of /pr/ for financial-sector mentions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of known Czech media trade-press domain

candidates.source_name: APRA – Asociace public relations (Czech PR agency association) member directory
candidates.why_relevant: Voluntary association of PR agencies operating in the Czech Republic, founded 1995, with a public directory of 26+ member agencies. Snowballing the member list yields the agencies whose client rosters and case studies name Czech banks, insurers and payment providers — an indirect but durable pointer to who announces what, and often to campaign material not present on corporate sites.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape of the member directory, then crawl each agency's reference/case-study page for financial-sector clients; refresh annually.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the Czech PR association domain

candidates.source_name: Komerční banka – Pro média / Tiskové zprávy
candidates.why_relevant: Newsroom of one of the three largest Czech banks and a PSE-listed issuer. Confirmed on fetch: three named press contacts, a directory of five in-house economists available for commentary (each with specialisation — a rare, directly useful expert map), recent releases dated August 2026 covering client numbers, fraud trends and macro forecasts, and a link to the press-release archive at /cs/o-bance/tiskove-zpravy. KB also pushes the same releases onto the ČTK Protext wire, so it is a good pair for measuring the newsroom-versus-wire lag.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of /cs/o-bance/tiskove-zpravy (the listing appeared to be client-rendered on fetch, so use a headless browser); also capture the economist directory once per quarter.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the standard Czech newsroom path pattern /o-bance/pro-media

candidates.source_name: Česká spořitelna – Pro média
candidates.why_relevant: Newsroom of the largest Czech retail bank (Erste Group). Confirmed on fetch: named spokesperson (Filip Hrubý) plus two press-centre officers with direct mobile numbers, and a stated scope of 'všechny kontakty, dokumenty a tiskové zprávy'. A dedicated media-contacts page exists at /cs/o-nas/pro-media/kontakty-pro-media. The press-release listing itself rendered as a shell on plain fetch, so it needs a browser-based collector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser crawl of /cs/o-nas/pro-media and its tiskove-zpravy child; cross-check against Protext and against Erste Group's press releases for group-level items.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the standard Czech newsroom path pattern /o-nas/pro-media

candidates.source_name: MONETA Money Bank – Tiskové centrum / Tiskové zprávy
candidates.why_relevant: The cleanest and most machine-friendly bank newsroom found in this sweep. Confirmed on fetch: releases dated and grouped by year with year filters (2026 back through 2015+), 'Další strana' pagination within each year, and a stable item URL pattern /servis-pro-media/tiskove-zpravy/detail/<slug> — for example the FY results release 'moneta-mezirocne-zvysila-svuj-cisty-zisk-o-8-1-procenta-na-3-3-miliardy-korun'. Note the path is 'servis-pro-media', not the more common 'pro-media' (the latter 404s), which is exactly the kind of drift that breaks stored links.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl by year page, follow 'Další strana', harvest /detail/<slug> items. Full historical backfill is feasible in one pass.
candidates.discovered_via_method: homepage link-snowball after /o-nas/pro-media returned 404

candidates.source_name: MONETA Money Bank – investor relations portal (investors.moneta.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Separate IR host for the PSE-listed bank, carrying current information, financial results and an IR calendar; live share price is sourced from pse.cz. There is an email-alert registration ('Chcete od nás dostávat aktuality?') which is the reliable low-latency channel for regulated announcements. Distinct from the press newsroom, and the pair is the clearest Czech example of regulated disclosure and PR travelling on separate rails.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /aktualni-informace, /financni-vysledky and /ir-kalendar; subscribe to the email alert for push notification of results.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from moneta.cz homepage ('Pro akcionáře')

candidates.source_name: Raiffeisenbank ČR – Informační servis / Pro média
candidates.why_relevant: Newsroom of a top-five Czech bank, notable for an unusual nested archive structure discovered by snowballing the homepage: press releases are foldered by year and apparently by sub-period, e.g. /informacni-servis/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy/tiskove-zpravy-2026/tiskove-zpravy-20268/. The site also exposes 'Povinně zveřejňované informace' and an investor-information page, so mandatory disclosure and PR are reachable from the same host. The obvious /o-nas/pro-media path 404s — the real path sits under 'informační servis'.
candidates.access_status: open (page content long/truncating on plain fetch)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Recursive crawl from /informacni-servis/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy following year folders; also snapshot /povinne-zverejnovane-informace for the disclosure workstream.
candidates.discovered_via_method: homepage link-snowball after /o-nas/pro-media returned 404

candidates.source_name: Air Bank – Pro novináře (journalist section)
candidates.why_relevant: A model example of the standardised Czech 'pro novináře' newsroom, and evidence that the local term is 'pro novináře' as often as 'pro média' — the /o-air-bank/pro-media/ path 404s. Confirmed on fetch: dated releases (multiple in August 2026 on ETFs, business loans, airport lounges and fraud reporting), two named press officers, a dedicated media mailbox novinari@airbank.cz, and downloadable press-kit assets (company profile, Air Bank and Zonky logo ZIPs, branch/card/staff photos, price list). Releases live under the /novinky/<slug>/ path, so news and press release share one namespace. Part of PPF Group, which makes it a window on PPF's banking communications.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /pro-novinare/ for the release index and /novinky/<slug>/ for full text; capture the press-kit file downloads once for the asset archive.
candidates.discovered_via_method: homepage link-snowball after /o-air-bank/pro-media/ returned 404

candidates.source_name: Fio banka – Média / Tiskové zprávy
candidates.why_relevant: Newsroom of an independent Czech bank/broker, with a two-track structure worth noting: 'tiskové zprávy' (formal releases) and a separate 'aktuality' stream that carries operational and security notices — the fraud/phishing warnings that never appear as formal press releases but are early indicators of payment-fraud trends. Item URLs carry a numeric id plus slug, e.g. /spolecnost-fio/media/tiskove-zpravy/327047-fio-banka-zavadi-bezpecnejsi-telefonicke-overeni.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl both /spolecnost-fio/media/tiskove-zpravy and /spolecnost-fio/media/aktuality; the numeric id prefix gives a stable dedupe key.
candidates.discovered_via_method: homepage link-snowball after /o-nas/pro-media resolved to the homepage

candidates.source_name: mBank CZ – tiskové centrum (hosted on the Polish group press platform)
candidates.why_relevant: A structurally interesting case: the Czech newsroom of mBank is not on mbank.cz at all but on the parent's Polish press platform under a cz. subdomain. Confirmed on fetch: Czech-language releases with dates (Aug 2026, Jul 2026 examples), pagination across seven pages, a /releases/news listing, a /presskits section, and a named PR specialist with direct contact. Anyone crawling only the .cz domain would miss this entirely — the same pattern is worth testing for other foreign-owned Czech banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /releases/news with pagination (7 pages observed) plus /presskits for assets; no RSS observed, so poll on a schedule.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link-snowball from mbank.cz homepage ('Tiskové centrum' pointing off-domain)

candidates.source_name: ČSOB – Pro média (newsroom, bot-defended)
candidates.why_relevant: ČSOB is one of the largest Czech banking groups (KBC) and a major payments actor, so its newsroom is a must-have. Every path attempted on csob.cz returned HTTP 500 to this fetcher, which is characteristic of edge-level bot defence rather than a missing page — a 500 (not 404) means the host answered. Recorded as a live-but-blocked candidate; the exact newsroom path still needs confirmation from a real browser session.
candidates.access_status: blocked to automated fetch (HTTP 500 on all attempted paths)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Collect via headless browser with realistic headers, or fall back to ČSOB releases carried on the ČTK Protext wire and on KBC Group's newsroom.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the standard Czech newsroom path pattern; three variants attempted
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on https://www.csob.cz/portal/csob/pro-media, /portal/o-csob/pro-media and /pro-media — host responds, content withheld

candidates.source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – corporate site / newsroom
candidates.why_relevant: Major CZ/SK cross-border bank whose Czech newsroom and mandatory-disclosure pages belong in the sweep. The root returned HTTP 403 to this fetcher — the standard signature of a WAF/bot filter on a live site, not a dead host. Newsroom path unconfirmed and deliberately not guessed here.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve the newsroom path via a real browser session, then collect headlessly; meanwhile capture UniCredit CZ items from the Protext wire.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the bank's corporate domain

candidates.source_name: Banka CREDITAS – corporate site / newsroom
candidates.why_relevant: Fast-growing domestic Czech bank and an active acquirer, so its announcement flow matters for market-structure tracking. Root returned HTTP 403 to this fetcher — bot-defended-but-live. Newsroom path unconfirmed; CREDITAS releases are in any case visible on the ČTK Protext wire, which is the practical fallback for exactly this class of mid-sized domestic actor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-based path discovery, then headless collection; fall back to Protext keyword sweep on 'CREDITAS'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the bank's corporate domain

candidates.source_name: Comgate – Pro média and 'Napsali o nás'
candidates.why_relevant: One of the few pure-play Czech payment service providers with a proper newsroom (payment gateway plus ~10,000 terminals, ~23,000 e-shops, ~53bn CZK processed annually, European payment-institution licence, direct Visa/Mastercard partner, PCI DSS L1). Two things make it valuable for this cell: the standard 'pro média' section, and a 'Napsali o nás' clippings page that names which Czech outlets cover the payments sector — a free, self-maintained pickup map. Note the domain moved: comgate.cz 301-redirects to comgate.eu/cs/.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /cs/pro-media and /cs/napsali-o-nas; the latter is a one-off harvest to seed the payments media-outlet list. Also watch /cs/blog-o-platebnich-sluzbach for product signals.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of comgate.cz, followed 301 to comgate.eu, then homepage link-snowball

candidates.source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) – Pro média
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech Banking Association's media section. ČBA is a sector-level announcer whose releases (e.g. the 'Makroekonomická prognóza ČBA – 3Q 2026' observed on the Protext finance category) carry cross-bank statistics and positions that no single bank publishes. The site also advertises a 'Zpravodajský servis' and 'ČBA Monitor'. The direct /tiskove-zpravy path returns the association's own 404 page, so the press-release listing sits elsewhere under the section and the page rendered as navigation only on plain fetch.
candidates.access_status: open but JS-rendered; exact release-list path unresolved
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser crawl of /stranky/pro-media to resolve the real listing URL; in parallel harvest ČBA items from the Protext wire, which carries them reliably.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the association domain, then homepage link-snowball

candidates.source_name: Česká národní banka – Tiskové zprávy (regulator newsroom with RSS)
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank's press-release archive is the deepest and best-structured newsroom found in this sweep: filterable by topic (11 categories including monetary policy, financial stability, banknotes/coins, regulation and supervision) and by year and month, spanning 1997 to 2026, with an RSS feed advertised in the footer at /cs/obecne/rss/. Included in this cell as newsroom infrastructure rather than as regulatory content: it is the reference implementation of what a Czech financial-sector press archive looks like, and it is the anchor that dates market-wide events other newsrooms react to.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the RSS feed for low-latency capture; backfill the 1997-2026 archive once via the year/month filter combinations.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the known regulator newsroom path

candidates.source_name: Burza cenných papírů Praha (Prague Stock Exchange) – Tiskové centrum a novinky
candidates.why_relevant: The exchange's own press centre and news stream, plus an events calendar (kalendar-udalosti) that pre-announces issuer reporting dates — a scheduling backbone for anticipating when Czech listed financials (Komerční banka, MONETA, Erste) will publish results. A burzovní newsletter signup exists. Note this covers exchange-level and issuer-facing announcements; the market-data pages are separate.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /tiskove-centrum and /novinky; harvest /kalendar-udalosti to build an earnings-date calendar; subscribe to the newsletter.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the exchange domain, then homepage link-snowball

candidates.source_name: Patria.cz – Korporátní zprávy / Regulatory Announcements feed
candidates.why_relevant: Patria Online (part of the KBC/ČSOB orbit) runs the main Czech investment portal and republishes issuer regulatory announcements in a dedicated 'KORPORÁTNÍ ZPRÁVY' feed. For this cell it is the second distribution rail alongside ČTK: mandatory disclosures from listed Czech financials surface here in a single consolidated stream, often faster and in a more parseable form than on the issuer's own IR site.
candidates.access_status: open (some analytics content may be gated)
candidates.legal_status: public; portal copyright on editorial content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the RegulatoryAnnouncements page daily; also crawl /zpravodajstvi/ and /akcie/ for issuer detail pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the leading Czech investment portal, then homepage link-snowball

candidates.source_name: KBC Group newsroom (parent-level distribution for ČSOB CZ)
candidates.why_relevant: Because csob.cz blocks automated access, the parent group's newsroom is the practical English-language substitute for group results and strategy items that cover the Czech business unit. Confirmed on fetch: 2026-dated releases including Q2 2026 results, PDF assets under /content/dam/kbccom/doc/newsroom/pressreleases/<year>/, and a press-release archive at /en/newsroom/press-release-archive/<year>/alle-onderwerpen.html. No Czech-specific releases were visible on the landing page, so treat it as a supplement, not a replacement, for the ČSOB CZ newsroom.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the year-based press-release archive and pull the linked PDFs; filter for Czech Republic / ČSOB mentions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: parent-company fallback after csob.cz returned HTTP 500

candidates.source_name: Erste Group – Press releases (parent-level distribution for Česká spořitelna)
candidates.why_relevant: Group-level press stream of Česká spořitelna's owner. Relevant because CEE-wide and capital/results announcements affecting the Czech subsidiary are frequently issued at group level in English before, or instead of, appearing on csas.cz. Fetch confirmed the press-releases page exists but returned only the header shell, so filters, date range, RSS and Czech-specific coverage are unverified.
candidates.access_status: open but content did not render on plain fetch
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser crawl; check for an RSS or alerts signup in the news-media section; filter items for 'Czech', 'Ceska sporitelna', 'CEE'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: parent-company traversal from Česká spořitelna

candidates.source_name: Mastercard Europe newsroom – Czech edition
candidates.why_relevant: Card schemes announce Czech market data, product launches and partnerships through localised newsroom paths rather than through local corporate sites, which makes the /news/europe/cs-cz/ path the natural home for Mastercard's Czech press releases. The fetch returned HTTP 403 — bot defence on a live host — so the structure and content are unverified and the path should be reconfirmed from a browser.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Confirm the localised newsroom path from a browser, then collect headlessly; cross-check against Protext, which carried a Visa-related Czech release in the finance category.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the scheme's localised newsroom path pattern

candidates.source_name: Finance.cz – banking news and 'Komerční sdělení' (paid-PR) stream
candidates.why_relevant: Mass-market Czech financial portal (operated under the iinfo.cz group) covering taxes, banks, calculators and rates. For this cell its value is the clearly labelled 'Komerční sdělení' items interleaved with editorial content: these are paid placements by financial and insurance companies, so the stream reveals which institutions are actively pushing messaging and on what themes, distinct from formal press releases. No dedicated 'tiskové zprávy' section was visible.
candidates.legal_status: public; sponsored content must be labelled
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /n/banky/ retaining the 'Komerční sdělení' flag as a metadata field so paid placements are never mistaken for editorial or for official releases.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of a leading Czech consumer-finance portal to test for PR republication

negative_findings.description: The WebSearch tool was unavailable for this entire slice: the first search call returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. Both attempted Czech-language queries ('ČTK Protext tisková zpráva distribuce banka platební služby' and 'Protext ČTK distribuce tiskových zpráv ceník archiv') were refused before execution.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SERP-based discovery was possible. All 30+ sources below were found instead by direct fetch of known/inferred Czech domains and by link-snowballing homepages, footers and category pages. Czech-language coverage was still achieved (all navigation, terms and paths used were Czech), but a cs-language search sweep of the seed queries has not been performed and this slice should not be treated as a completed cs-search pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-tail actors that have no guessable domain — small payment institutions, credit unions (spořitelní a úvěrní družstva), niche fintechs, PR agencies with financial clients — are exactly the ones a search sweep would surface and a domain-guessing sweep will miss. The cell's stated rationale (catching entities too small to have discoverable IR sections) is therefore only partly served.

negative_findings.description: financninoviny.cz, historically ČTK's dedicated economic/financial news domain, no longer serves its own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.financninoviny.cz/ returns HTTP 301 Moved Permanently to http://www.ceskenoviny.cz/ekonomika/.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored source registry entry or historical citation pointing at financninoviny.cz should be remapped to ceskenoviny.cz/ekonomika/. The economic wire has been folded into the general ČTK consumer site rather than discontinued.

negative_findings.description: No public entry point to ČTK's Infobanka news archive could be located.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.ctk.cz/sluzby/infobanka/ returned HTTP 404, and ibsearch.ctk.cz did not resolve at all (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). Infobanka is named as a service on https://www.ctk.cz/sluzby/ but the product page path is different from the obvious guess.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Infobanka is the deep historical archive of Czech agency reporting and the natural back-catalogue for banking and payments announcements older than the free web archive. Access will require going through ČTK commercially (ctk@ctk.cz, +420 222 098 111) rather than finding a public URL.

negative_findings.description: csob.cz refuses automated fetches across every path attempted.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on /portal/csob/pro-media, /portal/o-csob/pro-media and /pro-media. A 500 rather than a 404 indicates the host answered and withheld content — consistent with edge bot defence, not with a missing page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ČSOB is one of the largest Czech banking and payments groups; leaving it uncollected would be a material gap. Recorded as blocked-but-live, not dead. Interim workarounds: the ČTK Protext wire and the KBC Group newsroom.

negative_findings.description: Several financial-sector hosts returned WAF-style 403s to this fetcher.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden on https://www.unicreditbank.cz/, https://www.creditas.cz/ and https://www.mastercard.com/news/europe/cs-cz/. All three are near-certainly live sites behind bot filtering.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are hypotheses about accessibility, not verdicts about liveness. They should be routed to a browser-based collector rather than marked dead, and their newsroom paths remain unconfirmed — no path was invented for them here.

negative_findings.description: Two Czech media-monitoring vendors could not be reached because of TLS errors from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.anopress.cz/ failed with 'certificate has expired'; https://www.monitora.cz/ failed with 'self signed certificate'. Both errors occurred before any HTTP response, so nothing is known about the sites' content or liveness.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are the main alternatives to NEWTON Media for retrospective archives of Czech coverage. The identical class of failure across two unrelated hosts suggests a local TLS-interception artefact rather than two simultaneous vendor outages, so they must be re-verified rather than dropped.

negative_findings.description: globalpaymentseurope.eu no longer presents a valid certificate for its own name.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetch failed with 'Hostname/IP does not match certificate's altnames: Host: www.globalpaymentseurope.eu is not in the cert's altnames: DNS:0oo1.cz, DNS:www.0oo1.cz' — the hostname now resolves to infrastructure serving an unrelated domain.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Global Payments Europe was a significant Czech card-processing actor. The certificate mismatch is evidence that the web presence has been retired, rebranded or absorbed, which means its announcement channel needs to be re-identified under whatever the current corporate name is. Recorded as an unresolved lead, not as a dead company.

negative_findings.description: Three financial companies exposed no media section from their homepage navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: visa.cz homepage showed no 'tiskové zprávy', 'pro média' or newsroom links at all. jtbank.cz (J&T Banka) exposed only contacts, wealth report and investment-services links. partnersbanka.cz exposed only /o-nas, /pobocky and /kontakty. In each case the homepage was fetched successfully — the links are genuinely absent from it, though a section may exist deeper in the site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is precisely the pattern the cell exists to handle: where no corporate newsroom is discoverable, the ČTK Protext wire and the media-monitoring archives become the only systematic capture route for that actor. For Visa specifically, Czech announcements appear to run through the global newsroom or through partner releases — a Visa Czech Top Shop item was observed on the Protext finance feed, issued by a third party (INSTORE CONSULTING EU), not by Visa.

negative_findings.description: The 'obvious' Czech newsroom path /o-nas/pro-media or /o-bance/pro-media is unreliable across the sector.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404s were returned by moneta.cz/o-nas/pro-media (real path: /servis-pro-media/tiskove-zpravy), rb.cz/o-nas/pro-media (real path: /informacni-servis/pro-media), airbank.cz/o-air-bank/pro-media/ (real path: /pro-novinare/) and cbaonline.cz/tiskove-zpravy (association 404 page). fio.cz/o-nas/pro-media resolved to the homepage rather than a newsroom (real path: /spolecnost-fio/media/tiskove-zpravy). Only kb.cz and csas.cz matched the guessed pattern.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector built on a path template will silently lose most of the sector, and stored registry URLs will rot. Newsroom URLs must be resolved per-entity from homepage navigation and re-resolved periodically. The local vocabulary is broader than 'pro média': 'pro novináře', 'servis pro média', 'informační servis', 'tiskové centrum' and plain 'média' all occur.

negative_findings.description: Machine-readable feeds are largely missing from Czech bank newsrooms.
negative_findings.result_summary: No RSS feed was visible on the media sections of Komerční banka, MONETA, mBank CZ or Air Bank. RSS was confirmed only for Česká národní banka (footer link /cs/obecne/rss/) and for ceskenoviny.cz (footer RSS link). MONETA and the Prague Stock Exchange offer email newsletters instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell will be poll-and-diff HTML crawling rather than feed subscription for most corporate newsrooms, which raises both latency and fragility. It also strengthens the case for treating the ČTK wire as the primary rail: one crawlable, paginated, searchable archive covering many actors at once.

negative_findings.description: Several newsroom listing pages returned navigation-only shells to a plain HTTP fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: kb.cz/cs/o-bance/tiskove-zpravy, csas.cz/cs/o-nas/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy, rb.cz/informacni-servis/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy and cbaonline.cz/stranky/pro-media all returned headers and menus with no release items, despite HTTP 200. Items were visible on the parent /pro-media pages for KB and ČS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are client-rendered listings, not empty archives. A headless browser is required for collection; a naive crawler would record these high-value banks as having zero press releases.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language competitor to ČTK Protext was identified in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Protext (ČTK) and NEWTON Media's PR Studio are the only Czech press-release distribution products confirmed by fetch. No second national wire was found, and without WebSearch it was not possible to test for smaller or defunct distributors, so no local-language terms for such competitors could be gathered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Protext is effectively the single national wire, the collection design has a single point of failure and a single point of leverage. That conclusion is plausible from what was observed but is not established — it rests on absence of evidence produced by a tool constraint, not on a completed search.

coverage_gaps.description: The mandatory Czech-language search sweep of the cell's seed queries was never executed because the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted at the first call. Discovery ran entirely on direct fetch plus link-snowballing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with search available, executing all six seed queries plus extensions in cs and en ('distribuce tiskových zpráv', 'rozeslání tiskové zprávy médiím', 'tiskové centrum banka', 'press release distribution Czech Republic financial'). Treat the current slice as a strong domain-led baseline to be widened, not as a completed pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller and non-bank financial actors were not swept: credit unions (spořitelní a úvěrní družstva), small licensed payment institutions and e-money issuers, PSD2 third-party providers, and fintechs such as buy-now-pay-later and payment-gateway startups. Only Comgate was confirmed among pure-play PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Take the ČNB list of licensed payment institutions and credit unions as the actor spine, then for each entity test (a) a newsroom path from its homepage and (b) a Protext keyword query. Entities with no newsroom become wire-only sources — the exact case this cell was created to catch.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language and international distribution of Czech financial announcements is unmapped. It is unknown whether Czech banks or PSPs use GlobeNewswire, Business Wire, PR Newswire or EQS for English releases, although Protext itself claims reach into media in nearly 180 countries and offers an English-language filter.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test the Protext search with jazyk=angličtina and původ=ČR to size the English-language Czech flow first, since that is free and confirmed. Then check whether PSE-listed financials route regulated announcements through a commercial international wire.

coverage_gaps.description: The downstream mirror graph is unmapped. Protext states distribution to 27 Czech news portals, and ceskenoviny.cz/pr/ was confirmed as one of them, but the other mirrors were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain the portal list from the Protext client documentation, then verify each mirror. Mirrors matter for redundancy (if protext.cz blocks crawling) and for measuring pickup, and some mirrors retain items the origin later removes.

coverage_gaps.description: Four high-value targets are behind bot defences or transport failures and have no confirmed collection route: ČSOB (HTTP 500 on all paths), UniCredit Bank CZ (403), Banka CREDITAS (403), Mastercard CZ newsroom (403), plus Anopress and Monitora (TLS errors).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all of these to a headless-browser collector with realistic headers and polite rate limits, and re-verify from a normal network before any is recorded as unreachable. For ČSOB in particular, stand up the Protext and KBC fallbacks now so the actor is not simply absent from the corpus.

coverage_gaps.description: Licensing terms for bulk collection are unresolved for every archive in this cell: ČTK/Protext content reuse, ČTK Infobanka, NEWTON Media archive (1989-present), Anopress and Monitora. Robots and terms-of-use were not inspected for protext.cz or ceskenoviny.cz.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before any production crawl, read robots.txt and terms for protext.cz and ceskenoviny.cz, and get written scope for what may be stored and redistributed. Default to storing metadata plus links and keeping full text internal-only until licensing is settled; for the commercial archives, buy access rather than scrape.

coverage_gaps.description: The PR-agency layer was identified (APRA member directory, Mediář agency index) but not harvested, so the mapping from agency to financial-sector client has not been built.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scrape the APRA member list and the Mediář agency index, then crawl each agency's references/case-study pages for Czech bank, insurer and payment-provider clients. This yields early warning of campaigns and a route to announcements that bypass corporate newsrooms.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth is confirmed only for a few sources (Protext finance category around 440 pages and roughly 50,525 total records; ČNB 1997-2026; MONETA back to about 2015; NEWTON archive advertised from 1989). Depth is unknown for KB, Česká spořitelna, Raiffeisenbank, Air Bank, Fio and mBank CZ because their listings did not render.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During the first headless crawl, record the oldest retrievable item per newsroom as a depth metric, and prioritise the ČTK wire for any period predating a given company's own archive.

brief: Czech financial announcements run on two rails, and the wire is the stronger one: ČTK's Protext service (protext.cz, mirrored at ceskenoviny.cz/pr/ and, per the operator, 27 further portals) carries banks, the banking association, card schemes' partners and small payment firms alike, with a date/language/origin search over roughly 50,525 records and a finance-and-economics category running to about 440 pages — a single crawlable archive that persists after company pages change and that captures actors with no newsroom at all. Corporate newsrooms are the second rail and are markedly less tractable: paths drift far from the obvious /o-nas/pro-media template ('pro novináře' at Air Bank, 'servis pro média' at MONETA, 'informační servis' at Raiffeisenbank, an off-domain host at mBank CZ), listings are frequently client-rendered, RSS is almost absent outside ČNB, and ČSOB, UniCredit CZ and CREDITAS all refused automated fetches while remaining evidently live. Around these sit the retrospective archives and intermediaries — NEWTON Media (from 1989), Anopress and Monitora, plus the APRA and Mediář agency indexes — which are licensable rather than crawlable but reach back further than the free web. The main caveat on this slice is method: the session's web-search budget was exhausted before the first query, so everything here came from direct fetches and link-snowballing in Czech, and the long tail of small payment institutions and fintechs that a cs-language search sweep would surface remains unmapped.
